theme_strategy: Hybrid Theme: Organic & Earthy (Public) + Swiss/High-Contrast Functional (Internal CRM). Toggle between public site and admin dashboard context.

typography.instructions: Import Playfair Display and Outfit from Google Fonts. Do not use Inter or Roboto for headings.

layouts.public: Bento grids with generous spacing (gap-8 to gap-12). Asymmetrical layouts for feature sections. Large hero with bg-black/30 overlay to ensure text contrast.
layouts.internal_crm: Dense F-Pattern layout. Fixed dark sidebar (w-64). Main content area with grid-cols-4 and gap-4. Kanban boards utilizing full height for pipelines.

components.public_cards: No visible borders, subtle drop shadows (shadow-lg), large image to text ratio (70:30). Organic feel.
components.crm_cards: 1px solid border (border-border), no shadow, tight padding (p-4). Flat and objective.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for public marketing. Sharp/slight rounded (rounded-md) for CRM. Add hover state with slight translate-y and text color change.
components.status_chips: Small, rounded-full, distinct background colors (red/amber/green) with dark text for high contrast readability in CRM.
components.navigation: Public: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70). CRM: Solid dark left sidebar.

motion.public: Smooth scrolling, staggered fade-in up for property listings, subtle image zoom on hover.
motion.internal_crm: Minimalist micro-interactions. Instant feedback. Subtle background color shift on hover for table rows.

visual_enhancers.public: Subtle noise texture overlay. High-quality tropical architecture photography. Earthy, warm lighting.
visual_enhancers.internal_crm: Data-dense sparklines, clear status indicators, modified F-pattern for data scanning.

image_urls.description: Tropical modern house exterior with lush landscaping, perfect for the main hero.
Modern tropical house facade with wooden accents.

Smiling real estate agent with a for sale sign.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for all text. Use dark text on status chips in CRM.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all inputs (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the public site and CRM as distinct routing areas (e.g. / for public, /admin for CRM).
Use Playfair Display for public headings and Outfit for CRM headings. Outfit for all body text. Import these from Google Fonts.
Public site should feel airy and luxurious with gap-8 to gap-12, while CRM should be dense with gap-4.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use lucide-react for CRM icons and public site icons.
Use recharts for CRM dashboard visualizations.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds for the public header; use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-white/90.
Implement a Kanban board for the Sales/Leasing pipeline in the CRM.
Update tailwind.config.js to include the specific color tokens defined in the guidelines.
Do not use Inter, Roboto, Lato, or Open Sans. Do not use Space Grotesk.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Do not center align app container text globally.
Ensure high contrast on hover states.
Always provide a data-testid attribute for key interactive elements in kebab-case format.
Use pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
